description: This Java source file defines an Android ListActivity demonstrating efficient list handling during scrolling by avoiding expensive operations. It includes an inner class adapter, List13, and methods for managing list view state during scroll or fling events.

classes.name: List13
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that demonstrates optimizing list updates during scrolls by temporarily binding views to placeholder data and updating after scrolling stops.

classes.name: SlowAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter that conditionally binds actual data or 'Loading...' placeholder based on scrolling state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, sets the adapter, and registers scroll listener.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Empty implementation in this example; could be used for handling scroll events.

methods.name: onScrollStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the busy state and list item views when scroll state changes, also updates status text.
